fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-01-21 at about 21:20, it was reported that a green truck bearing registration number TN-38-XX-1054 belonging to the complainant was taken from Mullai Puram Parking Area in Thanjavur. The complaint was lodged by Vidhya Krishnan (9000000069). Ganesh Shankar (9000000155), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complaint mentions Pandian Thangaraj, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000427, in connection with the events. Nithin Velan (9000000004) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away from an industrial parking space at night.
fields.Keywords: truck theft, vehicle, truck, suspect, mobile number, parking area, CCTV, witness
